_meta.purpose: Pre-QA Stabilization 118 — Triage buckets per il prossimo Pack 119 POST-QA Fix and Polish. Categorizza le tipologie di issue che il Manual QA su device 118 puo' rilevare, e definisce la policy di fix sicuro.

triage_buckets.description: Errori di copy in italiano, label tradotti male, hint UI fuorvianti, badge/dot grafici scoordinati.
triage_buckets.fix_policy: frontend-only string change. No backend. No DB. No formula change.

triage_buckets.description: Overflow, safe area mancante, touch target < 44pt, gesture handler conflict.
triage_buckets.fix_policy: frontend-only layout fix. StyleSheet only. No business logic.
examples: Hero card overflow su iPhone SE
Menu item troppo piccolo su Android

triage_buckets.description: Endpoint read-only restituisce campo opzionale mancante, ordine inconsistente, payload non chiaro. NO change semantico.
triage_buckets.fix_policy: backend additive only (no rimozione campi, no rename). Validator 118 deve continuare a passare.
examples: hero-upgrade/readiness aggiunge campo opzionale notes per categoria

triage_buckets.description: Schermata gated mostra copy fuorviante (es. 'in arrivo presto') che promette cose non promesse.
triage_buckets.fix_policy: frontend-only copy change. Mantenere PreQaScreenGate intatto.
examples: Plaza dice 'arrivo bot a breve' (non promettere bot, 116B contract)

triage_buckets.description: Red Dot mostra count actionable per source deferred. Anti-fakedot violazione.
triage_buckets.fix_policy: frontend hook polish o backend find_one polish. Source 117B/116C invariata.
examples: Menu mostra '3' su mail anche se mail_unread e' deferred
Home dot pulsa anche senza warning safe attiva

triage_buckets.description: Log noisy, warning ripetuti, log troppo verbose. NO sensitive data.
triage_buckets.fix_policy: backend logging cleanup. Mai sopprimere errori reali.
examples: Log debug rimossi da production path

triage_buckets.description: Auth check mancante su endpoint nuovo read-only. Token validation lieve.
triage_buckets.fix_policy: backend additive auth Depends. Validator 118 verifica.

triage_buckets.description: Issue richiede attivazione live di sistema deferred (gacha, shop, mail claim, push, chat live). NON sicuro in 119.
triage_buckets.fix_policy: Documentare in audit ledger. Attendere Pack 120+ Controlled Live Unlock Prep o pack dedicated.

triage_buckets.description: Issue espone DB write, claim attivato, push attivato, mutation senza authorization. PACK 119 BLOCKER se rilevato.
triage_buckets.fix_policy: P0 fix immediato. Revert + harden + nuovo validator step.

pack_119_must_preserve: Pack 116A-EXT FIX-A team power source truth
Pack 116B chat/bot quality contract + legacy chat cleanup
Pack 116C red dot notification badge foundation
Pack 117A manual QA gate + deferred resolver readiness
Pack 117B mega read-only resolver sprint (block A COMPLETE + block B metadata_only_COMPLETE)
pack_119_must_not: usare git add -A o git add .
